name: Elemental Trial (Mythic)
body:
The elemental judgment dealt by your deity is absolute.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Trial.

Benefit(s): When you channel energy using the Elemental Trial feat, the ability functions now as mythic trial by fire (see above).
